recommendations.title: Triage delayed unsigned contracts
recommendations.rationale: Unsigned contracts exceed the illustrative review-time threshold.
recommendations.proposed_action: Review approval ownership and bottlenecks; escalate only after verifying contract status and policy.
recommendations.uncertainty: Contract durations and statuses are simulated; deal value is not equivalent to recoverable revenue.

recommendations.title: Review commission cost sensitivity
recommendations.rationale: Commission expense is calculated from closed-won bookings using an illustrative plan.
recommendations.proposed_action: Compare commission scenarios against budget and check eligibility, clawbacks and crediting rules.
recommendations.uncertainty: No compensation contract, payout eligibility or payroll data is modeled.

recommendations.title: Validate forecast overattainment
recommendations.rationale: Projected bookings exceed the quarterly target; unrealistic synthetic attainment may distort planning.
recommendations.proposed_action: Backtest stage probabilities and recalibrate pipeline generation and targets before making staffing decisions.
recommendations.uncertainty: Synthetic bookings are not evidence of actual commercial performance.

limitations: Stage probabilities and regional potential are uncalibrated assumptions.
Synthetic contracts are not real approval events.
Proposals are not executed and require human verification.
